crossRefs.note: I persecuted this Way to the death, binding and delivering into prisons both men and women.
But Saul ravaged the assembly, entering into every house and dragged both men and women off to prison.
But Saul, still breathing threats and slaughter against the disciples of the Lord, went to the high priest
“I myself most certainly thought that I ought to do many things contrary to the name of Jesus of Nazareth.
But beware of men: for they will deliver you up to councils, and in their synagogues they will scourge you.

translations.web: I said, ‘Lord, they themselves know that I imprisoned and beat in every synagogue those who believed in you.
translations.bsb: ‘Lord,’ I answered, ‘they know very well that in one synagogue after another I imprisoned and beat those who believed in You.
translations.kjv: And I said, Lord, they know that I imprisoned and beat in every synagogue them that believed on thee:
translations.asv: And I said, Lord, they themselves know that I imprisoned and beat in every synagogue them that believed on thee:
